title: ExpandedMannequins
description: WIP Mod designed to make mannequin management easier.
body:
WIP Mod for the "Mannequin" Entity.


Current features:
- /mannequin spawn
- Mannequin death messages (/expandedmannequins deathMessages)
- Mannequin descriptions (/mannequin description)
- Mannequin hiding/showing descriptions (/mannequin hideDescription)
WIP features:
- Mannequin inventories
Do /mannequin scan to toggle mannequin scanning.
Do /expandedmannequins verbose to get more info when running commands.
